description: Verifies the gravitational deflection of a light ray grazing the solar limb, integrated with the adaptive Dormand-Prince scheme in SI units from -1000 to +1000 solar radii: the deflection agrees with the first-order result 4GM/(c^2 R) within a relative 1e-4 and with the second-order post-Newtonian result within a relative 1e-5, while the null constraint residual stays below 1e-11.

checks.label: every adaptive step stays above the minimum step size
the ray reaches the far boundary of the integration domain
the deflection matches 4GM/(c^2 R) within a relative 1e-4
the deflection matches the second-order post-Newtonian result within a relative 1e-5
the null constraint residual stays below 1e-11 along the whole ray
